mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 9.0% indicates a severely weakened labor market, which typically triggers further monetary stimulus and fiscal support, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS < 340000) and housing starts (HOUST < 460) signals a broad-based demand contraction, which often leads to policy interventions that boost equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS < 340000 and HOUST < 460.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (UNRATE > 8.5%), a low level of industrial production (INDPRO < 97) indicates severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns as the market prices in further economic deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5% and INDPRO < 97.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market strength (HOUST > 460) indicates a recovering consumer sector, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 460.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly increase in unemployment (UNRATE rise > 0.5 percentage points) signals worsening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates a deeper recession.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS < 340000) and housing starts (HOUST < 460) signals a broad-based demand weakness, which often triggers policy responses that boost equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS < 340000 and HOUST < 460.

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain an accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0%.
